id_policy: Proposed IDs extend the client catalog; allocation and package versioning require review.
type_syntax: WIT value types; null means no result. Types below are records and enums are named WIT enums.
argument_convention: For each hook or service, generate one named input record from a nonempty arguments map, or no parameter for an empty map. Sort record fields by WIT field name, independent of JSON object order; null result means no return value.

identity.player: Canonical UUID string; not a username or an entity handle.
identity.entity: Proposed opaque u32 handle scoped to the open world epoch; valid across hooks and ticks until the entity is removed, changes dimension, or the world closes. Native zero sentinels for absent entities map to none at the ABI boundary; present entities map to some(handle). Handles from earlier epochs must never resolve.
identity.block_entity: Opaque u32 handle to an in-flight block entity, valid only during its callback. It is not an entity handle.

failure_policy: Fail closed for host operations. A failed listen contributes nothing; a failed collect preserves the current aggregate; a failed cancel does not add a cancellation; a failed mutate preserves the current value. Earlier successful host operations are not rolled back.
chat_recipients_semantics: When all is true, only is ignored; otherwise only is the exact UUID allowlist, including an empty list.

hooks.name: register_commands
hooks.fallback: Contribute no commands; retain earlier registrations.

hooks.name: perform_command
hooks.fallback: Do not claim or cancel the command.

hooks.name: server_tick
hooks.phase: server tick start/end, including whether a world is running

hooks.name: world_lifecycle
hooks.fallback: Skip this callback; invalidate handles on close regardless.

hooks.name: block_entity
hooks.rationale: A host-created typed entity starts with an empty compound; ownership and compatibility with other constructors need review.

hooks.name: block_entity_ticks
hooks.composition: OR the result with the current ticks value; false never clears an earlier true.
hooks.rationale: Ticker selection changes live block entity behavior and must compose with earlier hooks.

hooks.name: block_entity_tick
hooks.phase: block entity tick, while the entity is in flight
hooks.fallback: Apply no additional changes; preserve already successful host operations.
hooks.rationale: Typed synchronous operations must target the borrowed in-flight entity and preserve other NBT fields and sync ordering.

hooks.name: block_entity_update_tag
hooks.thread: server or snapshot worker; no host imports
hooks.operation: True requests a host-side copy of the complete current native NBT into the update tag; false preserves the current aggregate.
hooks.rationale: The copy must preserve unknown NBT and work safely on the server and snapshot worker without live host imports.

hooks.name: net_from_client
hooks.fallback: Drop the mod packet without changing vanilla packet handling.

hooks.name: server_chat_listened
hooks.fallback: Contribute false; preserve any earlier true.

hooks.name: server_chat
hooks.composition: A returned cancellation only adds cancellation; other fields replace the current values in dispatch order.
hooks.fallback: Preserve current message, recipients, system flag and cancellation state.
hooks.rationale: Recipient and cancellation changes must compose with earlier chat hooks without widening delivery on failure.

hooks.name: attack_entity
hooks.rationale: Existing dispatch covers LAN guests; confirm or add an equivalent authoritative local-player path.

hooks.name: living_incoming_damage
hooks.phase: before applying damage, with borrowed damage context
hooks.fallback: Preserve current damage and do not add cancellation.
hooks.rationale: Damage mutation and cancellation must compose in native order without reentering the borrowed entity.

hooks.name: living_knockback
hooks.phase: before applying knockback, with borrowed damage context
hooks.fallback: Preserve current knockback and do not add cancellation.
hooks.rationale: Knockback mutation and cancellation must compose without reentering borrowed state.

hooks.name: hears_projectile_impacts
hooks.fallback: Contribute false; preserve any earlier true.

hooks.name: player_input
hooks.rationale: Existing dispatch covers LAN guests; confirm or add equivalent authoritative host/local input dispatch.

hooks.name: use_item
hooks.rationale: Specify a lossless, bounded representation for item components without exposing the live stack.

hooks.name: interact_entity
hooks.rationale: Specify a lossless, bounded representation for item components without exposing the live stack.

services.name: break_block_as
services.fallback: Fail closed: an Err leaves everything unchanged.
services.doc: Breaks the block as that player's tool would (drops with Fortune/Silk Touch, tool damage, experience, statistics, mod events); false when the game refuses (protected, adventure mode...).

services.name: player_sneaking
services.fallback: Return an error; the caller skips the feature.
services.doc: Whether the player is sneaking (the LAN host and single player's owner included).

services.name: container_slots
services.fallback: Return an error; the caller skips the feature.
services.doc: Every slot of the container at the position; both halves of a double chest, in the game's own order.

services.name: container_set_slots
services.fallback: Fail closed: an Err leaves everything unchanged.
services.doc: Replaces the slots (same length as container-slots); refused unless the item totals (id + components) are conserved and no stack exceeds its limit.

services.name: containers_in
services.fallback: Return an error; the caller skips the feature.
services.doc: Containers within the radius (at most 64); a double chest is one entry at its first half.

services.name: player_set_slots
services.fallback: Fail closed: an Err leaves everything unchanged.
services.doc: Replaces the player's 36 main slots (hotbar first); refused unless the item totals are conserved.

services.name: block_tags
services.fallback: Return an error; the caller skips the feature.
services.doc: The tags (without #) a block id is in.

services.name: item_tags
services.fallback: Return an error; the caller skips the feature.
services.doc: The tags (without #) an item id is in.

services.name: block_tool_requirement
services.fallback: Return an error; the caller skips the feature.
services.doc: Hardness, whether a tool is required, the mineable/* tags and the needs_*_tool tier tag of a block.

services.name: can_harvest
services.fallback: Return an error; the caller skips the feature.
services.doc: Whether this tool (none = bare hand) harvests the block's drops.

services.name: player_attribute_modifier_add
services.fallback: Fail closed: an Err leaves everything unchanged.
services.doc: Adds a transient modifier; fails when one with that id exists.

services.name: attribute_get
services.fallback: Return an error; the caller skips the feature.
services.doc: The base and the modified value of a player's attribute.

services.name: open_menu
services.fallback: Fail closed: an Err leaves everything unchanged.
services.doc: Opens a mod menu for the player (the host's native menu).

services.name: menu_set_items
services.fallback: Fail closed: an Err leaves everything unchanged.
services.doc: Sets the items of the player's open mod menu.

services.name: menu_close
services.fallback: Fail closed: an Err leaves everything unchanged.

services.name: item_entities_in
services.fallback: Return an error; the caller skips the feature.
services.doc: Dropped items within the radius (at most 64 blocks, 256 entries).

services.name: item_entity_move
services.fallback: Fail closed: an Err leaves everything unchanged.
services.doc: Moves a dropped item and sets its velocity (a magnet).

services.name: item_entity_pickup
services.fallback: Fail closed: an Err leaves everything unchanged.
services.doc: The player picks the dropped item up now (what fits; the rest stays dropped).

services.name: give_items
services.fallback: Fail closed: an Err leaves everything unchanged.
services.doc: Gives stacks to the player; the stacks that did not fit are returned, not dropped.

services.name: advancement_progress
services.fallback: Return an error; the caller skips the feature.

services.name: advancement_grant

services.name: entity_vitals_of

services.name: hurt_entity

services.name: server_player_motion

services.name: set_server_player_velocity
services.fallback: Fail closed: an Err leaves everything unchanged.

services.name: play_sound_at
services.fallback: Fail closed: an Err leaves everything unchanged.

services.name: set_player_attack_hitbox
services.fallback: Fail closed: an Err leaves everything unchanged.
services.doc: A hit box for the player as a target, separate from the collision box (server reach and Horizon clients' crosshair).

services.name: clear_player_attack_hitbox
services.fallback: Fail closed: an Err leaves everything unchanged.

services.name: world_border
services.fallback: Return an error; the caller skips the feature.

services.name: set_world_border
services.fallback: Fail closed: an Err leaves everything unchanged.
services.doc: Sets the border's centre and size; with target-size and lerp-ticks it moves from size to target-size over the ticks.

services.name: mod_call
services.fallback: Fail closed: an Err leaves everything unchanged.
services.doc: Calls another package's handle-call (server module): payloads up to 1 MiB, nested depth 4, never back into a caller that is waiting.

services.name: player_remove_slot
services.fallback: Leave the slot unchanged when it does not exactly match; errors leave the inventory unchanged.
services.doc: Clears one exact slot only when item id, count and all components match. Slot ids are 0-35 main, 36-39 armor, 40 off hand and 41 cursor.

services.name: attachment_define
services.fallback: Fail closed: an Err leaves everything unchanged.
services.doc: Declares a data attachment owned by this package (id namespace = package id; kind: player, entity, block-entity, chunk or level). Redefining with the same policy is fine.

services.name: attachment_get
services.fallback: Fail closed: an Err leaves everything unchanged.
services.doc: Reads an attachment value (opaque bytes) from a holder: a player UUID, an entity id (decimal), x,y,z, cx,cz, or empty for the level.

services.name: attachment_set
services.fallback: Fail closed: an Err leaves everything unchanged.
services.doc: Stores bytes (at most 64 KiB) on a holder; synced attachments are sent to the clients that see it.

services.name: attachment_remove
services.fallback: Fail closed: an Err leaves everything unchanged.
services.doc: Removes the value; true when there was one.

services.name: config_get
services.fallback: Return Err without changing state.
services.doc: Read the calling mod's declared value. Exactly the field indicated by kind is meaningful.

services.name: config_set
services.fallback: Return Err without changing state.
services.doc: Validate before persisting and notifying; clients cannot set server-authoritative keys.

services.name: has_permission
services.fallback: Return Err without changing state.
services.doc: Only declared nodes may be granted; explicit player rule overrides the declared op-level default.

services.name: storage_get
services.fallback: Return Err without changing state.
services.doc: Access only the calling mod's client or server store; missing keys return none and values over 1 MiB require blob reads.

services.name: storage_put
services.fallback: Return Err without changing state.
services.doc: Atomic bounded write; enforce at most 256 MiB per mod per world, without symlink or junction escape.

services.name: storage_delete
services.fallback: Return Err without changing state.
services.doc: Delete only the calling mod's key and release its quota.

services.name: storage_blob_begin
services.fallback: Return Err without changing state.
services.doc: Reserve quota before receiving a blob; partial writes are not visible as committed values.

services.name: storage_blob_write
services.fallback: Return Err without changing state.
services.doc: Write bounded chunks to an owned pending blob; preserve its quota reservation.

services.name: storage_blob_commit
services.fallback: Return Err without changing state.
services.doc: Atomically publish only a complete, quota-reserved blob.

services.name: storage_blob_abort
services.fallback: Return Err without changing state.
services.doc: Discard an owned pending blob and release its reserved quota.

services.name: storage_blob_read
services.fallback: Return Err without changing state.
services.doc: Read a bounded slice of a committed value.
